name: Raspberry Pi Edge Telemetry Daemon & Hardware Monitor
author: Russell Alan Powers
description: Production-grade edge telemetry daemon for Raspberry Pi and IoT gateways. Gathers real-time CPU thermals, memory metrics, GPIO pin states, sensor payloads, and hardware health, dispatching structured alerts and telemetry to local databases and n8n automation pipelines.

functions.name: poll_telemetry
functions.description: Collects a comprehensive telemetry snapshot from edge sensors and hardware controllers.
functions.signature: poll_telemetry(simulate: bool = False, thermal_spike: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]

functions.name: evaluate_health
functions.description: Evaluates telemetry snapshot against SLA safety thresholds, returning operational health classification and triggered alert payloads.
